messages:
Alex D.: quick microcopy check — in the Help menu the button currently reads `Keyboard shortcuts` and the hover tooltip expands to a one-line blurb. design wants to try a shorter label 'Shortcuts' to save space. any objections?
Priya R.: i'd keep 'Keyboard shortcuts' for discoverability. 'Shortcuts' feels vague to new users. if space is tight, maybe 'Shortcuts (⌘/Ctrl)' — explicit and still short.
Sam L.: implementation note — hover tooltip width is limited on narrow screens. also on mobile we show a separate entry 'Tap to open shortcuts' since no keyboard.
Jordan (A11y): accessibility concerns: the control needs an aria-label that fully describes the action for screen readers. suggestion: `aria-label="Open keyboard shortcuts overlay"`. tooltip content shouldn't be focusable; tooltip text should be exposed via `aria-describedby` only when the button receives focus.
Priya R.: +1 on the aria-label. for visible text i'd propose: button = 'Shortcuts', tooltip = 'View keyboard shortcuts and navigation keys'. keeps visible text compact while tooltip clarifies. can we fit that in 40 chars?
Alex D.: tooltip container max ~40 chars, so "View keyboard shortcuts" is 23 chars, add "and navigation keys" pushes it to ~44. maybe truncate to 'View keyboard & navigation shortcuts' (34 chars).
Sam L.: that works. i'll update the tooltip copy and add a mobile fallback 'Open shortcuts' text for the list entry. also will wire up `aria-label="Open keyboard shortcuts overlay"` per Jordan.
Jordan (A11y): one more nit — avoid parentheses inside tooltip for screen reader output. keep punctuation simple. also confirm keyboard focus order includes the help button before the profile menu.
Priya R.: updated copy suggestion list: button = 'Shortcuts' (visible), tooltip = 'View keyboard & navigation shortcuts' (non-focusable), aria-label = 'Open keyboard shortcuts overlay'.
Alex D.: perfect. can someone PR the tiny copy change + a11y attributes? adding to this week's design review agenda. @Sam L. can you do the PR? :thumbsup:
Sam L.: yep i'll open PR and tag y'all for review. will include a short screenshot and the aria code snippet in the description.
console-bot: design review item created: "Help menu shortcuts microcopy & a11y" — added to agenda for next Tues.
